name: NONOGRAM VR: A PUZZLE GAME
summary:
# A relaxing VR puzzle experience built around classic nonogram/picross gameplay.

Solve grid-based logic puzzles using number clues. Take out the correct cubes, mark the correct ones, and complete each level. No timers. No pressure. Just you and the puzzle.
